_comment: The fields the SPA actually reads and sends, and only those. Both services check themselves against this file: the backend proves its OpenAPI still offers them (backend/evals/test_frontend_contract.py), and the frontend proves its test doubles and its source still match (frontend/tests/contract.test.js). Renaming a field on one side fails on both until the other side is updated. Routes the SPA does not call are deliberately absent - the admin GETs an operator reaches with curl are covered by backend/tests/test_admin_api.py, which derives its list from the app itself.

error_shape._comment: src/api/client.js reads detail first, then the first value of the first field. Login also reads non_field_errors[0]. A closed campaign's 403 also carries a code: src/Gate.jsx reads "campaign_suspended" (its aspirant is not approved).
error_shape.code: string, on a closed campaign's 403 only

no_content._comment: Routes that answer 204 with no body. Only that they still exist is checked.
